chunks: Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Ja'far ibn Bashir, from Dawud ibn Sirhan, who said:
Abu 'Abdillah عليه السلام said, regarding the shroud of Abu 'Ubaydah al-Hadhdha': “The hanut is only camphor, but go and do as the people do.”

key_terms.النَّاسُ: the people, referring here to common practice
key_terms.الْحَنُوطُ: the perfuming substance applied in funeral preparation
key_terms.الْكَافُورُ: camphor, identified here as the hanut
key_terms.فَاصْنَعْ: then do; an instruction to act
key_terms.كَفَنِ: the burial shroud used for the deceased

ai.seo_question: What does Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام say about hanut and camphor in the shrouding of the deceased?
ai.summary: This hadith addresses a matter related to funeral preparation, specifically the use of hanut in the shrouding of the deceased. Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام states that hanut is camphor, while also instructing that one may proceed in accordance with common practice among the people in this case.
